name: local_flow
description: Local only: review a Jira card, plan it, code it — one step at a time, with the card's memory kept on this laptop.

triggers.name: issue_key
triggers.description: The Jira card, e.g. KS-6. Needed for review, plan and memory.

triggers.name: answers
triggers.description: Your answers to the review's open questions, each starting with its number: Q1: ...  Q2: ...  Kept for every later run; nothing is posted to Jira.

triggers.name: services
triggers.description: The services to design for, e.g. ui (comma-separated, main one first). Empty: the ranking decides.

triggers.name: uploaded_files
triggers.description: review: a document with your answers (optional). plan: the review report and any other files (optional). code: the TDD PDF (required).

triggers.name: branch_name
triggers.description: The new branch's name. Empty: fix/<card>-<number>.

triggers.name: target_branch
triggers.description: The branch the pull request goes into. Empty: the branch the TDD was written from.
